director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
pata nahi, aap batao
Aaj hum scale se lambai naapenge, metre aur centimetre mein. Toh shuru karte hain?
mujhe lagta hai haan

Cricket bat ka handle bhi scale se naapte hain. Scale par 0 se 1, 1 se 2, har khaana 1 centimetre ka hai. Pencil 0 se 7 tak rakhi hai: 7 khaane, toh 7 centimetre. Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

director.text: 9 cm

9 cm sahi nahi hai. Ek aur tareeka dekhte hain. Nishaan nahi, khaane gino. 2 se 5 tak teen khaane hain: 2 se 3, 3 se 4, aur 4 se 5. Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: pata nahi
Ungli 6 wale nishaan par rakho, aur 10 tak ek-ek khaana kood kar jao. Har kood ek centimetre hai. Toote scale par 6 se 10 tak rakhi chabi kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 10 cm
Nahi, 10 cm theek nahi. 10 par chabi rukti hai, par shuru 6 par hoti hai; pehle wale khaane chabi mein nahi aate. Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

seams.form: Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.

director.text: 4 cm lambi

Sahi jawab, kyunki chabi ke neeche chaar khaane aate hain, 6 se 10 tak: 10 − 6 = 4. Chalo, pehle wale sawaal ki taraf wapas aate hain. Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

seams.form: Chalo, pehle wale sawaal ki taraf wapas aate hain.

director.text: sawaal kya hai?
3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak rakhe crayon ki lambai kitni hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

director.text: 6 centimetre

Haan, sahi hai. 3 se 9 tak 1-1 centimetre ke 6 khaane hain, yaani 9 − 3 = 6 centimetre. Scale ka pehla khaana 0 aur 1 ke beech hota hai. Jo cheez 1 se shuru hoti hai, uske neeche woh pehla khaana aata hi nahi. Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?

director.text: picture dikhao
Yahan wahi scale hai, aur patte ke sire se ginti shuru karke dikhayi hai: 1 se 2 tak pehla khaana. 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak rakha patta kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?

director.text: 7 centimetre lamba

Bilkul sahi: pehla khaana patte ke neeche nahi aata. Golu ka scale toot gaya, ab woh 4 se shuru hota hai. Uske khaane bhi 1-1 centimetre ke hain: cheez jahan se shuru ho, wahin se khaane gino. Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?
director.card: Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

director.text: 12 ka nishaan

Sahi jawab, kyunki 4 se aage 8 khaane chalo toh 12 aata hai: 4 + 8 = 12. Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge. Golu ka toota scale 4 ke nishaan se shuru hota hai. Uspar ek tehni 5 ke nishaan se 12 ke nishaan tak rakhi hai. Tehni ki lambai nikaalni hai. Tehni ki lambai ke liye 12 mein se kaunsa nishaan ghataoge?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge.

director.text: tehni ka shuru ka nishaan
Haan, 12 mein se 5, kyunki tehni 5 se shuru hoti hai. Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 12 cm
12 cm sahi nahi hai. 12 tehni ka doosra sira hai, lambai nahi; lambai ke liye shuru wala nishaan bhi dekhna hota hai. Toote scale par 5 se 12 tak rakhi tehni kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: mujhe khud try karne do
Haan, pehle tum try karo.
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 7 cm

Haan, sahi hai. 12 − 5 = 7 khaane tehni ke neeche hain, aur har khaana 1 centimetre ka hai. Toh poora jawab: tehni 7 centimetre lambi hai. Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari. Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?

director.text: chaar cm
Sahi jawab, kyunki rubber ke neeche 5 se 6, 6 se 7, 7 se 8 aur 8 se 9: 4 khaane, toh 4 centimetre. Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?
director.card: Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?

director.text: red

Bilkul sahi. Neela 3 se chalkar 9 tak jaata hai, toh bas 6 centimetre; laal poore 7, isliye laal lamba. Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?

director.text: Hindi mein bolo
Haan, ise Hindi mein bolti hoon. Bat pakadne wali jagah 6 wale nishaan se 15 wale tak hai. Woh jagah kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Bat pakadne wali jagah 6 wale nishaan se 15 wale tak hai. Woh jagah kitne centimetre ki hai?

seams.form: Haan, ise Hindi mein bolti hoon.

director.text: nau centimetre lamba

Haan, bilkul theek: ginti grip ke shuru wale 6 se hoti hai, toh 15 − 6 = 9 khaane, yaani 9 centimetre. Chhoti cheezein centimetre mein naapte hain. Ab dekhenge ki lambi cheezon ke liye metre kya hai, aur ek metre mein kitne centimetre. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
chauka

Wah, chauka! Toh tumhara favourite yahi hai. Ab phir se apni baat par aate hain. Yeh ek metre ki lakdi hai. Ispar 0 se 100 tak centimetre likhe hain: 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100. Toh 1 metre mein 100 centimetre hote hain. Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

seams.form: Ab phir se apni baat par aate hain.

j2.line: Wah, chauka! Toh tumhara favourite yahi hai.

director.text: phir se bolo
70 ke nishaan tak aane wala bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

director.text: Sahi jawab, kyunki bat ke upar 70 se 100 tak 30 centimetre bacha. Yeh lamba feeta hai, jis par sirf 10-10 centimetre ke nishaan hain. Jahan metre ka number likha hai, wahan poora metre hota hai; do numberon ke beech das chhote khaane. Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?
director.card: Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?

director.text: 140 cm

Haan, sahi hai. Parda 1 metre wale nishaan se 4 chhote khaane aage hai, har ek 10 centimetre, toh 1 metre 40 centimetre. 1 metre 5 centimetre ka matlab: ek poora metre, yaani 100 centimetre, aur 5 centimetre aur. Toh 105 centimetre. Ek ribbon 2 metre 8 centimetre lambi hai. Ribbon kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Ek ribbon 2 metre 8 centimetre lambi hai. Ribbon kitne centimetre ki hai?

director.text: 28 cm

28 cm sahi nahi hai. Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain. 4 metre 2 centimetre mein chaar poore metre hain, aur har metre 100 centimetre ka hai. Unke baad bas 2 centimetre aur, toh kul 402 centimetre. Inmein sabse lamba kaun hai: 1 metre 5 centimetre ka pipe, 70 centimetre ka dhaaga, ya 90 centimetre ka danda?
director.card: Inmein sabse lamba kaun hai: 1 metre 5 centimetre ka pipe, 70 centimetre ka dhaaga, ya 90 centimetre ka danda?

seams.form: Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain.

director.text: danda

Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. 1 metre 5 centimetre ko 15 padhne se metre chhota ho gaya; usmein 100 centimetre gino, phir teeno ko milao. 1 metre 5 centimetre ka pipe, 70 centimetre ka dhaaga, 90 centimetre ka danda: inmein sabse lamba kaun?
director.card: Inmein sabse lamba kaun hai: 1 metre 5 centimetre ka pipe, 70 centimetre ka dhaaga, ya 90 centimetre ka danda?

director.text: 1 metre 5 centimetre wala

Bilkul sahi: pipe 1 metre 5 centimetre, yaani 105 centimetre hai, jo danda ke 90 aur dhaage ke 70 se zyada hai. Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain. Ek ribbon 2 metre 8 centimetre lambi hai. Ribbon kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Ek ribbon 2 metre 8 centimetre lambi hai. Ribbon kitne centimetre ki hai?

seams.form: Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain.

director.text: 208 cm ki

Sahi jawab, kyunki 2 metre = 200 centimetre, aur 200 + 8 = 208 centimetre. Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain. Ek rassi 3 metre lambi hai. Usmein se 40 centimetre kaat diya. Kitni rassi bachi, metre aur centimetre mein? 40 centimetre ghatane se pehle 3 metre ka kya karoge?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain.

director.text: change to centimetres

Haan, pehle 3 metre ko centimetre mein badlenge, kyunki 40 centimetre mein hai. 300 mein se 40 gaye, toh 260 centimetre rassi bachi. Tumhari baari: 260 centimetre rassi, metre aur centimetre mein kitni hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: 260 centimetre rassi, metre aur centimetre mein kitni hai?

director.text: do metre aur saath centimetre

Haan, sahi hai. 260 mein do poore sau hain, yaani 2 metre; bache 60 centimetre. Toh poora jawab: bachi hui rassi 2 metre aur 60 centimetre hai. Ab agla sawaal tumhare liye. Bijli ka ek khamba 6 metre ooncha hai. Khamba kitne centimetre ooncha hai?
director.card: Bijli ka ek khamba 6 metre ooncha hai. Khamba kitne centimetre ooncha hai?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 600 cm
Haan, bilkul theek: 6 metre mein 6 baar 100 centimetre aate hain, yaani 600 centimetre. Aadha metre kitne centimetre hota hai?
director.card: Aadha metre kitne centimetre hota hai?

director.text: Bilkul sahi, kyunki 1 metre 100 centimetre hai, aur 100 ka aadha 50. Ek dupatta 1 metre ka hai, ek ribbon 90 centimetre ki, aur ek dori 95 centimetre ki. Inmein sabse lamba kaun hai: dupatta, ribbon ya dori?
director.card: Ek dupatta 1 metre ka hai, ek ribbon 90 centimetre ki, aur ek dori 95 centimetre ki. Inmein sabse lamba kaun hai: dupatta, ribbon ya dori?

director.text: dupatta wala

Sahi jawab. Dupatta 1 metre, yaani 100 centimetre hai, jo dori ke 95 aur ribbon ke 90 centimetre se zyada hai. Ab tum metre aur centimetre dono jaante ho. Aage dekhenge ki bina scale ke ungli aur lambe kadam se andaaza kaise lagate hain, aur kis cheez ke liye kaunsi unit. Yahan tak saaf hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan

Tumhari ek ungli ki chaudai lagbhag 1 centimetre hai. Aur Papa ka ek lamba kadam lagbhag 1 metre ka hota hai. Papa ne cricket pitch ki chaudai lambe kadam bhar kar paar ki, aur gina: ek, do, teen. Pitch lagbhag kitne metre chaudi hai?
director.card: Papa ne cricket pitch ki chaudai lambe kadam bhar kar paar ki, aur gina: ek, do, teen. Pitch lagbhag kitne metre chaudi hai?

director.text: lagbhag 3

Haan, sahi hai: Papa ke ek kadam mein lagbhag ek metre, toh teen kadam mein lagbhag 3 metre. Chhoti cheez par ungliyan ek ke baad ek rakho aur gino. Rubber par 4 ungliyan aayin, har ungli lagbhag 1 centimetre, toh rubber lagbhag 4 centimetre. Ab apni copy ki chaudai par ungliyan rakh kar naapo. Copy lagbhag kitne centimetre chaudi hai?
director.card: Ab apni copy ki chaudai par ungliyan rakh kar naapo. Copy lagbhag kitne centimetre chaudi hai?

director.text: unnees

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki lagbhag 15 se 20 centimetre, ungliyon jitna. Lambai suno toh ungli aur kadam se milao. Kamra 5 centimetre ka bataya, toh woh bas lagbhag 5 ungliyon jitna hua: number theek ho sakta hai, par unit galat hai. Zoya ne apni pencil 15 metre lambi likhi. Sahi naap kya hoga?
director.card: Zoya ne apni pencil 15 metre lambi likhi. Sahi naap kya hoga?

director.text: centimetre hona chahiye

Bilkul sahi. Pencil ungliyon se naapte hain: 15 centimetre. Ab ek sawaal milkar, aaram se hal karte hain. Bina scale ke chhat ki lambai ka andaaza lagana hai. Naap teen hain: ungli lagbhag 1 centimetre, baalisht lagbhag 15 centimetre, aur Papa ka lamba kadam lagbhag 1 metre. Ungli, baalisht ya Papa ka lamba kadam: chhat ke liye kaunsa loge?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, aaram se hal karte hain.

director.text: lambe dag se

Haan, chhat bahut lambi hai, toh Papa ka lamba kadam sabse theek naap hai. Tumhari baari: Papa ne chhat 7 lambe kadam aur aadha kadam mein paar ki. Chhat lagbhag kitni lambi hai, metre aur centimetre mein?
director.card: Tumhari baari: Papa ne chhat 7 lambe kadam aur aadha kadam mein paar ki. Chhat lagbhag kitni lambi hai, metre aur centimetre mein?

director.text: 7 metre 50

Sahi jawab. Toh poora jawab: chhat lagbhag 7 metre 50 centimetre lambi hai, kyunki 7 lambe kadam lagbhag 7 metre, aur aadha kadam lagbhag 50 centimetre. Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo. School bus ki lambai lagbhag kitni hogi? Unit ke saath batao.
director.card: School bus ki lambai lagbhag kitni hogi? Unit ke saath batao.

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo.

director.text: lagbhag 11 metre

Haan, sahi hai: bus ki lambai Papa ke kai lambe kadam jitni hai, isliye metre. Zoya ka kehna hai ki ghar ka darwaza 2 centimetre ooncha hai. Papa lagbhag 170 centimetre lambe hain. Is baat mein kya galat hai?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki ghar ka darwaza 2 centimetre ooncha hai. Papa lagbhag 170 centimetre lambe hain. Is baat mein kya galat hai?

director.text: centimetre nahi metre

Haan, bilkul theek. 2 centimetre bas do ungliyon jitna; darwaza toh Papa ke lagbhag 170 centimetre se bhi ooncha hota hai. Tum abhi jis kamre mein ho, uski lambai Papa ke lambe kadamon se andaaza lagao. Kamra lagbhag kitne metre lamba hai?
director.card: Tum abhi jis kamre mein ho, uski lambai Papa ke lambe kadamon se andaaza lagao. Kamra lagbhag kitne metre lamba hai?

director.text: 5 centimetre

Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Ise doosri tarah samajhte hain. Number ke saath unit bhi suno: 4 metre ka rubber kamre jitna lamba hota, aur 5 centimetre ki almaari maachis jitni. Pehle socho, cheez ungli jitni chhoti hai ya Papa ke kadam jitni lambi. Ek bade neem ke ped ki oonchai lagbhag kitni hogi? Unit bhi saath mein batana.
director.card: Ek bade neem ke ped ki oonchai lagbhag kitni hogi? Unit bhi saath mein batana.

director.text: centimetre

Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Chhoti unit ungli jitni hai; ped ko ungli-ungli karke naapo toh ginti hazaar se bhi upar jaati. Unit ke saath batao, bada neem ka ped zameen se upar tak kitna ooncha hota hai?
director.card: Ek bade neem ke ped ki oonchai lagbhag kitni hogi? Unit bhi saath mein batana.

director.text: centimetre
Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Papa ko ped ke neeche khada socho, aur dekho ki ped ungliyon jitna hai ya Papa ke kai kadam jitna. Apna jawab bolo, jaisa bhi lage.
director.card: Ek bade neem ke ped ki oonchai lagbhag kitni hogi? Unit bhi saath mein batana.

seams.form: Apna jawab bolo, jaisa bhi lage.

director.text: lagbhag 5 metre

Sahi jawab, kyunki ped ke neeche se upar tak Papa ke bahut saare kadam lag jaate, isliye uski oonchai metre mein. Ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Tum abhi jis kamre mein ho, uski lambai Papa ke lambe kadamon se andaaza lagao. Kamra lagbhag kitne metre lamba hai?
director.card: Tum abhi jis kamre mein ho, uski lambai Papa ke lambe kadamon se andaaza lagao. Kamra lagbhag kitne metre lamba hai?

seams.form: Ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain.

director.text: saadhe chaar metre

Haan, sahi hai: kamre mein Papa ke kuch hi lambe kadam aate hain, chhote kamre mein 3 se 6; jitne kadam, lagbhag utne metre. Ab poore paath mein se bas ek sawaal aur aata hai. Rangoli ka border 2 metre lamba banana hai, aur har ribbon 50 centimetre ki hai. Kitni ribbon lagengi?
6 sahi nahi hai. Har ribbon aadha metre ki hai. Ek metre mein aisi kitni aati hain, pehle yeh socho. 2 metre ke border ke liye 50-50 centimetre ki kitni ribbon chahiye?
Nahi, 5 theek nahi. Iska jawab hai 4, kyunki 2 metre = 200 centimetre; har ribbon 50, yaani aadha metre: ek metre mein do, toh chaar ribbon. Ab tak samajh aaya?
jaise aapne samjhaya tha, waise hi kiya

Achha, theek hai, maine sun liya. Aaj scale par khaane gin kar lambai naapi, aur dekha ki 1 metre mein 100 centimetre hote hain. Phir ungli aur lambe kadam se khud andaaza lagaya. Aaj ka kaam aasaan laga ya thoda mushkil?
thoda mushkil, thoda aasaan
Hmm, theek hai, samajh gayi. Aaj tumne pehchaana ki darwaza 2 centimetre nahi, lagbhag 2 metre ooncha hota hai. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain!
